insights.one_liner: Canadian family-owned frozen-food maker best known for fries, with Dutch roles in Amsterdam and Lelystad that attract many applicants.

culture.text: A frozen-food company best known for potato products such as fries.
Current jobs here are in finance, data and operations, in Amsterdam and Lelystad.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (McCain Foods Holland B.V.).
2 of its 3 current jobs here don't require Dutch.
Roles here draw about 188 LinkedIn applicants on average, so competition is very high.

growth.text: Appointed Victoriano Perez Mies, a former PepsiCo Europe executive, as Chief Manufacturing and Operations Officer.
Is piloting AI-powered crop monitoring with Ceres AI to support potato growers.

worth_knowing.text: A McCain heiress is pushing for a stock market listing and plans a family meeting about it.
